# Layout-test font fixture

Cinzel Decorative, weight 900, retrieved from the Google Fonts stylesheet for the same family/weight used by the Fellowship page. Retained under the SIL Open Font License in OFL.txt.

Source: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/cinzeldecorative/v19/daaHSScvJGqLYhG8nNt8KPPswUAPniZQa-lD.ttf

Used only by browser tests via an intercepted request. It is not shipped as a site asset. Loading it explicitly prevents a fallback font from concealing narrow-screen title clipping.
